packages.title: Nebula

manifest.title: Nebula
manifest.appDescription: Nebula: add-on browser + player for webOS. An Apple TV-style player (glass controls, thick rounded scrubber, remaining time), a pause board that shows what is playing and what is next, a playback-info HUD, subtitle timing nudges, a picture-quality policy, a live-edge button, a sleep timer (by minutes or when the episode ends), Start over for anything in progress, Surprise me on series pages, a featured hero board, a TV guide of the live and upcoming events your add-ons list, a Home you arrange yourself (pick the rows and their order), recent searches, a full keyboard shortcut set with a ? sheet on computers, full-bleed title pages with logo art and cast (press a name for that person's films and series), My List with an upcoming-episode calendar, resume and Continue Watching, next-episode autoplay that keeps your source and quality (the next stream is chosen before this one ends), a Nebula Profile that carries your add-ons, progress and My List to every device (sign the TV in with a code from your phone, no email), up to six who's-watching profiles with their own pictures, add-ons and settings, friends by @handle, subtitle appearance controls, and search across every catalogue. Opens full on first run. Plays and decrypts every format.

packages.shortDescription: Add-on browser + player: library, sync, calendar. Add add-ons by phone QR.

manifest.title: Nebula Beta
manifest.appDescription: A beta of Nebula drawn natively on the TV, without a browser: smoother menus, its own buffering engine, live channels and protected streams played by the app itself, a dropped stream picked up again at the same second, and the Magic Remote's pointer on every screen. It reads the same Nebula Profile as the regular app (add-ons, Continue Watching, My List, settings) and installs beside it, so both can stay on the TV. Sign in with the code it shows, from your phone.
